player_prompt.intro:
Unguwele Mdlali {player_id} ku JoJoJoin, umdlalo odlalwa phezu kwetabho ye 5x5 leyenombolo zeceli zibhalwe 0-24.
Ekuseni kwakho, beka isikhala sakho phezu kwe cela elingenamuntu, njengaku '[12]'.
UWINA ngokuwa nemikhala eyine ya wena elandelanayo — emikhala eyine elandelanayo ngendlela yehlathi, phezulu, noma diagonally.
Njenge Mdlali {player_id} ungu '{symbol}'; isitha sakho yena '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Lokutfutsa lokwentiwe akukafaneli kulandzele indlela lefanele.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} akusiyo inombolo levumelekile. Kumele ibe emkhatsini wa-0 na-24.
